اعتدلوا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَدَلُوا (iʕtadalū) /iʕ.ta.da.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
# اِعْتَدِلُوا (iʕtadilū) /iʕ.ta.di.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَدَلَ (iʕtadala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
